notes:
へら is a flat utensil used for mixing, stirring, flipping, and scraping in cooking. The shape and material vary by purpose.

TYPES:
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧べら / ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧へら: wooden spatula (for stir-frying)
- ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧べら: rubber/silicone spatula (for scraping bowls)
- ⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧⟦{返|がえ}→返す：09648_kaesu⟧し: metal turner (for flipping)

- へら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: to mix with a spatula
- へら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧: to flip with a spatula
- へら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧う⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: to fold (cut and fold motion)
